policy.preserve: Product capability, user value, control meaning, data boundary and proven failure behavior.
policy.may_change: Screen, route, label, schema, provider, component and implementation may change behind an explicit adapter and proof.
policy.briefing_position: News and audio are downstream prepared-intelligence modes selected by the Brain, not the product hero or a competing memory system.
policy.retirement_gate: No protected component may be disabled, deleted or made unreachable until its replacement passes characterization, data-boundary, failure, rollback and zero-live-caller proof, followed by exact founder approval for the retirement action.
policy.default_on_uncertainty: Quarantine or retain behind an adapter. Never infer retirement from a new interface working.

capabilities.name: Authentication, tenancy and owner-bound access
capabilities.product_value: A private Brain remains attributable to the correct person and audience without making the user administer security.
capabilities.target_role: Every new Brain read and write proves subject, owner, workspace, audience, purpose and authority before content access.
characterization_proof: Cross-user reads fail closed
Anonymous access cannot discover protected records
Audience changes invalidate derived access
retirement_conditions: Replacement passes multi-identity behavioral tests
All protected callers use the replacement
Rollback restores prior owner boundary

capabilities.name: Cross-verified AI-native news curation
capabilities.product_value: The leader receives a small, corroborated view of the AI shifts that can change a live decision, category view or preparation need.
capabilities.target_role: A prepared-intelligence service queried by live decisions, objectives, category questions and briefing compilation rather than a default feed hero.
characterization_proof: Independent-source corroboration survives
AI-native filtering and exact category semantics survive
Freshness and source standing remain visible
Shared pool and leader-specific ranking do not diverge
Thin supply stays honest
retirement_conditions: Replacement matches or improves held-out curation quality
Briefing and prepared objects share the same qualified pool
All cache and cron callers are mapped and cut over
Old pool can be restored without data loss

capabilities.name: Personalised read, listen and talk-back briefing
capabilities.product_value: A busy leader can absorb prepared intelligence by reading or listening and ask a grounded follow-up without opening a technical workspace.
capabilities.target_role: Audio is a presentation and conversation mode of one prepared object. It never owns a separate truth or curation pipeline.
characterization_proof: Read and audio express the same prepared object
Audio ownership and rate limits survive
Follow-up answers are grounded in the current briefing and carry citations
Failure recovers to readable content
Reduced-motion and mobile controls remain usable
retirement_conditions: New prepared-object renderer passes read, listen, pause, resume, retry and talk-back journeys
Audio reuse and signed URL behavior are preserved
Old player can be restored independently

capabilities.name: Briefing tuning, watchlist, voice steering and negative feedback
capabilities.product_value: The user can shape what reaches them, reject irrelevant patterns and steer future briefings without becoming a feed administrator.
capabilities.target_role: One calm control plane bends prepared intelligence across read, audio and delivery, with provenance-tagged rules and reversible feedback.
characterization_proof: A change affects every briefing mode
Negative feedback suppresses recurrence without erasing history
Voice and manual edits cannot silently clobber one another
Exclusions fail closed
The user can inspect and reverse material steering
retirement_conditions: One replacement control owns every current writer
Legacy duplicate writers have zero callers
Feedback history remains interpretable and reversible

capabilities.name: Decision decomposition, retrieval, verification and counter-case
capabilities.product_value: A consequential decision is challenged by evidence and a strong counter-case while the final call remains human.
capabilities.target_role: A modular evidence and challenger service called only after the human prior, decision boundary and evidence need are understood.
characterization_proof: Typed claims and exact source links survive
Corroboration is based on independent evidence rather than model agreement
Counter-evidence cannot be collapsed into a confident average
Partial provider failure is visible
The human call remains distinct from the recommendation
retirement_conditions: New service passes the old evidence fixtures and new million-dollar-decision cases
No active case depends on old writes
Historical cases remain inspectable

capabilities.name: Decision watch and briefing cross-engine return loop
capabilities.product_value: A past call can return when the evidence beneath it changes, turning the Brain into continuing help rather than a static answer archive.
callers_or_triggers: Decision watch schedule or bounded return-ask
capabilities.target_role: A permissioned return-ask service that reopens a decision only when a named load-bearing assumption or external condition moves.
characterization_proof: Alerts are idempotent
Only load-bearing changes trigger return
The reason for return links to the original call and fresh evidence
Dismissal or correction prevents recurrence
The alert can enter briefing without becoming generic news
retirement_conditions: Replacement proves the full decision to monitor to prepared return loop
Duplicate and stale alerts are impossible
Old scheduled caller is disabled only after new readback

capabilities.name: Encrypted, owner-scoped and correctable memory lifecycle
capabilities.product_value: Useful context persists without becoming an uncorrectable model memory or exposing the user to silent cross-boundary reuse.
capabilities.target_role: Legacy fact memory becomes an input adapter to the versioned Brain and cannot silently become accepted judgement.
characterization_proof: Encryption remains row-bound
Owner checks precede decrypt and write
Verification, expiry and supersession remain distinct
Third-party identity guardrails survive
Ambiguous legacy facts enter as proposals or quarantine
retirement_conditions: Every trusted row has subject, owner, source, meaning and applicability
Correction replay covers all derived consumers
Legacy read and write callers are zero
Export and erasure parity pass

capabilities.name: Correction propagation, contradiction handling and self-healing receipts
capabilities.product_value: One natural-language correction repairs what the Brain believes, what it shows and what it exports without rewriting history.
capabilities.target_role: A first-class repair service over append-only events and replaceable projections.
characterization_proof: Original evidence remains intact
Every affected projection is invalidated or rebuilt
Cached and exported copies are marked stale
Correction cannot cross subject or audience boundaries
A visible receipt names what changed
retirement_conditions: Seeded correction repairs every registered dependent artifact
Rollback can reconstruct the prior projection without deleting history
No hidden legacy cache remains authoritative

capabilities.name: Living Brain projection, relationships and explainable context selection
capabilities.product_value: The user can see what the Brain knows, how ideas connect, what is uncertain and why a piece of context affected a decision.
capabilities.target_role: One canonical current projection derived from Brain events, with the Living Map as an honest inspectable and marketable view rather than the storage model.
characterization_proof: Every displayed relationship is evidence-backed and typed
Context selection records why each item was chosen
Uncertainty and stale state remain visible
Graph absence does not block core value
Projection never outranks event history
retirement_conditions: New projection serves every active consumer
Living Map passes sparse, dense, contradictory and corrected fixtures
Old profile adapters have zero direct consumers

capabilities.name: Evidence-anchored candidate, rejection suppression and small experiment
capabilities.product_value: The system can challenge a leader tentatively without diagnosing them, and learns only after they confirm or reject the read.
capabilities.target_role: The candidate-before-commit pattern becomes a general durable-learning proposal primitive across judgement, taste and standards.
characterization_proof: Thin evidence stays a tension rather than diagnosis
Rejection suppresses an unchanged candidate
Confirmation revalidates every source
Burn removes the sensitive artifact while retaining a content-free suppression anchor
No learning occurs from a rejected proposal
retirement_conditions: General proposal service passes all Blind Spot qualification and rejection cases
Sensitive historical objects retain their burn path
Old candidate writers have zero callers

capabilities.name: Human prior, final authority, off-record mode and inspectable approvals
capabilities.product_value: The leader supplies the first and last judgement gates and can withhold, correct, reject or keep material off record.
data_contracts: Accepted, resisted, corrected and unresolved states
capabilities.target_role: Human agency is a system invariant across every consequential workflow, not reassuring copy at the end.
characterization_proof: No model output becomes a human call
Off-record paths write no durable content
Approval is specific to exact meaning and effect
A user can abstain without penalty
Another model may audit but cannot assume accountability
retirement_conditions: Replacement proves first and last human gates across all consequential paths
No direct write bypass remains
Off-record behavior is tested against every capture adapter

capabilities.name: Low-friction voice capture and transcription
capabilities.product_value: A busy user can contribute rich context or correct meaning without typing or learning a workflow.
capabilities.target_role: Voice is a one-tap input and response mode whose transcript remains inspectable and whose durable residue is separately proposed.
characterization_proof: Permission denial has a usable text fallback
Recording state is obvious
Transcript can be corrected before learning
Raw audio retention follows consent
Voice input never broadens purpose
retirement_conditions: Every approved capture route has voice and text parity where promised
Raw audio and transcript lifecycle is proven
Old capture path has zero callers

capabilities.name: Context export, Claude handoff and read-only MCP
capabilities.product_value: The user owns a useful Brain outside CTRL and can bring the right context into the AI surface where they already work.
capabilities.target_role: A deterministic Brain release compiler creates human-readable and machine-readable packages for Claude, GitHub, ZIP and read-only agent access.
characterization_proof: Export contains enough context to answer without phantom references
Every included item has source and audience authority
Revocation stops future MCP access
Re-import proposes changes rather than overwriting live truth
Two agent environments can use the package
retirement_conditions: New compiler achieves byte-stable export from identical approved state
Claude and a second materially different agent pass held-out tasks
Old token and export callers are migrated
Rollback restores prior export format

capabilities.name: Reusable judgement and skill compiler
capabilities.product_value: Repeated quality, taste and process judgement can become inspectable reusable machinery instead of one giant prompt or repeated explanation.
capabilities.target_role: Specialist modules compile bounded aspects of the Brain into testable packages. The old Kit surface stays retired while its machinery survives.
characterization_proof: Every rule links to evidence and owner acceptance
Packages contain tests and negative examples
Staleness is detectable after source change
No single generated file claims to be the entire Brain
A failed quality gate cannot release
retirement_conditions: Replacement compiler passes package and release tests
Existing packages remain retrievable
Every legacy writer is mapped
Old Kit UI is not required for the capability

capabilities.name: Company, category and model-market enrichment
capabilities.product_value: The Brain can know the leader's actual company, category and changing external environment without asking them to restate public facts.
capabilities.target_role: Research is commissioned by a specific evidence gap and returns source-backed proposals, never accepted personal truth.
characterization_proof: Mismatch fails closed
Every external fact has source and retrieval time
Research cannot overwrite internal truth
Unsupported public scarcity remains explicit
Provider failure degrades honestly
retirement_conditions: Replacement matches company recognition and decision enrichment fixtures
Cache and provider fallbacks are mapped
No stale enrichment is treated as current

capabilities.name: Model routing, cache, rate limits and factual guardrails
capabilities.product_value: Complex AI work stays reproducible, bounded and honest even when a provider is slow, expensive, unavailable or confidently wrong.
capabilities.target_role: One policy layer selects models by bounded task contract and preserves traces without logging unrestricted personal content.
characterization_proof: Fallback does not widen authority or purpose
Caches invalidate on Brain or policy change
Rate limits are owner and task scoped
Numbers, quotations and dates are checked outside generation where possible
Degraded states cannot masquerade as success
retirement_conditions: All consequential model callers use the central task registry
Provider-specific logic has zero hidden callers
Cost and latency bounds pass
Rollback can restore the prior policy

capabilities.name: Email, no-login delivery and quiet notification controls
capabilities.product_value: Prepared value reaches a busy leader in channels they already use, at a cadence controlled by the operator and user.
capabilities.target_role: A governed delivery service sends only an approved prepared object through Mindmake-controlled channels and respects timing, quiet state and withdrawal.
characterization_proof: Retry cannot duplicate a send
Unsubscribe and pause win over schedule
Email and app show the same object
No-login delivery does not weaken access
Operator timing is auditable
retirement_conditions: Replacement passes retry, overlap, pause and unsubscribe tests
All scheduled and webhook callers are mapped
Old delivery can be restored without duplicate sends

capabilities.name: Scheduled learning, curation, delivery and cleanup
capabilities.product_value: The Brain stays fresh and useful without the user remembering to maintain it, while retries remain safe.
capabilities.target_role: A registry of bounded background jobs whose purpose, owner, schedule, authentication, idempotency and failure state are inspectable.
characterization_proof: Every job has one owner and one schedule
Overlapping runs converge
Authentication fails closed
Failure leaves the last valid state visible
Disabling a job does not silently disable its product promise
retirement_conditions: Replacement job is active and read back
Old job is unscheduled only after overlap proof
Rollback schedule and credentials are ready
Dependent promises remain true

capabilities.name: Retention, erasure, account deletion and billing convergence
capabilities.product_value: A user can control how long data remains, remove sensitive learning and leave without being charged or leaving inaccessible residue.
capabilities.target_role: Retention and withdrawal are domain invariants applied to raw sources, Brain events, projections, caches, exports and billing.
characterization_proof: Retention choices alter eligible data only
Deletion cancels billing before erasure
Derived copies and exports are covered
Anonymous callers cannot force global maintenance
Burn and correction remain distinct
retirement_conditions: Replacement erasure map covers every new domain and old store
Readback proves no inaccessible residue
Billing and delivery state converge
Recovery evidence exists before destructive cutover

capabilities.name: Responsive, accessible, recoverable interaction primitives
capabilities.product_value: The non-technical user experiences calm continuity across mobile, desktop, loading, sparse data and provider failure.
capabilities.target_role: Reuse proven interaction primitives inside the new radically simple surfaces without preserving old navigation or verbal clutter.
characterization_proof: Primary action remains obvious on 320px and desktop
Keyboard and screen-reader paths work
Loading communicates useful progress without invented success
Sparse state is intentional
Recovery never duplicates writes
retirement_conditions: Replacement component passes the same state and viewport matrix
No active surface imports the old primitive
Visual change receives its own material approval when required

capabilities.name: Progress, calibration and held-out evaluation machinery
capabilities.product_value: The product can prove whether the Brain is becoming more useful without turning the leader into a tacky scoreboard or mistaking engagement for progress.
capabilities.target_role: An internal evaluation service measures judgement coverage, answerability, calibration, distinctiveness and outcome learning. Customer expression stays meaningful and non-competitive.
characterization_proof: Progress cannot increase from file count alone
Baseline and Brain treatment are frozen and comparable
Abstention and correction burden count
Business outcome and personal capability remain distinct
No unsupported score becomes a marketing claim
retirement_conditions: New evaluation suite reproduces historical useful signals
Metric definitions and data availability are explicit
Any customer-facing construct receives separate founder approval

capabilities.name: Billing, entitlement and webhook recovery
capabilities.product_value: Paid capability can be granted and withdrawn reliably without contaminating Brain truth or blocking data ownership.
capabilities.target_role: Commercial packaging can change after value proof while billing integrity and data portability remain independent of plan state.
characterization_proof: Webhook replay is idempotent
Entitlement does not become evidence authority
Downgrade preserves owned exports
Deletion cancels active billing
Pricing truth has one owner
retirement_conditions: New offer and entitlement contract is approved
Webhook and cancellation paths pass
Old price and plan callers are zero
Rollback is ready
